title: Repository configuration rebuild onto opum-workflow (OPAG-38): CLAUDE.md trim, hooks, settings
description:
Orchestrator-directed (opum-agent OPAG-38, 2026-09-05): quest-cli's own repository configuration rebuild onto the fleet's single plugin, opum-workflow, per the greenfield Claude-Code-cutover campaign (opum-agent docs/stories/greenfield-claude-code-cutover.md, decision record PLAN.md 2026-09-04). The fleet decision is a Claude Code-only estate: one memory file per repo (CLAUDE.md), AGENTS.md retired, opum-workflow's plugin hooks doing session-tracker bookkeeping instead of repo-local hook scripts.

This is a configuration/hygiene task, not a product feature: quest-cli the PACKAGE is unaffected (it still generates AGENTS.md for external users by default, and now CLAUDE.md via QCLI-227's --target flag); this task is about how THIS repository's own dev-time agent memory and session tooling are configured.

Comes after QCLI-227 (landed, PR #264, merged a4db056) since criterion 4's AGENTS.md question was held pending a supported CLAUDE.md target.

Four criteria as given verbatim by the orchestrator:
1. CLAUDE.md is about 200 lines (of repo-owned prose; the byte-identical, digest-guarded opum:fleet-operating block is excluded from that count) and carries no retired machinery.
2. lore check exits 0 and quest doctor is clean.
3. Plugin enabled; hooks fire and their Quest writes land.
4. Retired artifacts deleted and the settings file is in the right place for this repo's visibility.

Known constraints/blockers going in:
- Criterion 3: opum-workflow's session-end hook writes its tracker note only when exactly one task is In Progress. This repo currently has two (QCLI-196, QCLI-207/QCLI-97.5), both real unfinished parity/migration parent tasks with no honest way to close early. QCLI-229 (filed this session) tracks the missing legal exit from In Progress. Per orchestrator ruling: criterion 3 is recorded as satisfiable only after QCLI-229 ships or one of the two closes on its own merits - not to be worked around.
- AGENTS.md's fate is a genuine cross-repo coordination question, not a unilateral local decision: it carries the "opum-agent shared skill source: ..." authority-marker line that opum-agent's own migration-launch-fence gate (assertNoMigrationLaunchFence, tooling/agent-skills/src/source-migration.mjs) substring-checks on origin/dev. Deleting or relocating it without opum-agent's own gate being updated in lockstep breaks that gate silently - explicitly warned against in this repo's own CLAUDE.md. Raised to the orchestrator before acting.
- .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored) carries Stop/Notification hooks by absolute machine path into another repo's tooling directory (/Volumes/external/repos/opum-agent/tooling/opum-fleet/hooks/); orchestrator says delete rather than repoint (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT does not expand in a repo's own settings file), since the user-scope plugin already provides both.
- No committed .claude/settings.json exists yet; needs exactly an env block (OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR, OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN) with nothing machine-specific.
- .claude/skills/ already inspected: holds only lore/quest SKILL.md, nothing Backlog-era or ECK-derived - already clean, no action needed there.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CLAUDE.md's repo-owned prose (excluding the byte-identical opum:fleet-operating block) is about 200 lines and contains no retired-machinery references (herdr-as-message-channel, Treehouse, opum-worktrees, backlog-handover) except deliberately-kept dated historical records
lore check exits 0 and quest doctor reports a clean workspace

Criterion 3 (plugin hooks fire and their Quest write lands) is either demonstrated with an observed tracker note from a real headless run, or explicitly recorded as blocked on QCLI-229/closing one of the two current In-Progress tasks, with the reason stated rather than worked around

AGENTS.md's disposition is settled in coordination with opum-agent (owner of the migration-launch-fence gate that reads its authority-marker line) before any deletion or content move, not decided unilaterally here

.claude/settings.local.json's repo-local Stop/Notification hook entries pointing at another repo's tooling path are removed, and a committed .claude/settings.json exists carrying exactly an env block (OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR, OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN) with nothing machine-specific, placed correctly for this repo's public visibility

implementationNotes: AC1 (CLAUDE.md length/retired-machinery): repo-owned prose is now 179 lines (351 total minus the untouched 172-line opum:fleet-operating block, lines 140-311) - close to the ~200 target, consistent with the orchestrator's 'already near target' read. Removed the only live retired-machinery instruction found in the editable regions: the 'Sibling sessions' table's herdr-based 'Reach it' column and the 'Pane ids move between sessions... herdr agent read <pane>' line, replaced with ListAgents/SendMessage per the fleet block's own already-stated mechanism. The two remaining Treehouse/AGENTS.md mentions in the repo-profile section are dated historical records (correctly left per the fleet's own retirement-scope rule), now updated to state the marker's readers are gone rather than still-load-bearing.

AC2 (lore check / quest doctor): both re-verified clean AFTER all CLAUDE.md edits and the AGENTS.md deletion - 'lore check': 63 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 7 out-of-bundle links skipped, exit 0. 'quest doctor': healthy: true, no issues, exit 0.

AC3 (criterion 3, hooks): confirmed structurally blocked right now, not worked around. Read the actual opum-workflow plugin hook source (opum-marketplace/hooks/_lib.sh:42-47, flush-state.sh) rather than reasoning from memory: opum_active_task pipes 'quest task list --status In Progress --json' through 'head -2' and joins with a space; flush-state.sh's case statement treats any result containing a space as the *' '* ambiguous branch ('No tracker note was written'), and only the exactly-one-id branch appends a real note. This repo currently has THREE In-Progress tasks (QCLI-196, QCLI-207/QCLI-97.5, and this one, QCLI-230, claimed honestly rather than left in an inconsistent To Do while actively worked) - guaranteed to hit the ambiguous branch. Per the orchestrator's prior ruling, not forcing a dishonest completion of QCLI-196/207 to manufacture a passing demo; recording per QCLI-229 (no legal non-terminal exit from In Progress exists yet) as the reason this stays unsatisfied until QCLI-229 ships or one of the two stale parents is honestly closed on its own merits.

AC4 (AGENTS.md disposition): raised to opum-agent (owner of the migration-launch-fence gate) before acting. They independently re-verified and reported the gate and its whole tooling/agent-skills directory were deleted from opum-agent on 2026-09-04 - re-verified myself directly against opum-agent's own checkout (no tooling/agent-skills directory; no source/config anywhere mentions the marker, assertNoMigrationLaunchFence, or source-migration; opum-agent's own CLAUDE.md states 'there are no receipts, no identity string to preserve, and no launch fence to measure') rather than taking either claim on faith. Confirmed the from-source replacement actually works before deleting anything: using this exact checkout's src/cli/main.ts (NOT the installed @opum-ai/quest 0.3.2 package - this repo is the one place that can run the from-source binary), ran 'agents --update-instructions --target claude' then 'agents --check --require-installed --target claude', both exit 0 / state current, against this real CLAUDE.md. Put the final call to my own user (this repo's AGENTS.md is a separate question from the fleet-wide hold, since our CI can use the from-source CLI) via AskUserQuestion; approved. AGENTS.md deleted.

AC5 (settings): .claude/settings.local.json's Stop/Notification hooks pointing at /Volumes/external/repos/opum-agent/tooling/opum-fleet/hooks/*.sh removed (file now {} - still gitignored per .gitignore, so this is a local-only change, nothing to commit). New committed .claude/settings.json holds exactly an env block: OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR=quest-cli-session, OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN=jdnewhouse - the handle, not the email, since this repository is public.
finalSummary: Rebuilt quest-cli's own agent configuration onto the opum-workflow plugin. CLAUDE.md: removed the last live retired-machinery instruction (herdr-based peer-reaching, replaced with ListAgents/SendMessage), corrected two now-stale migration-launch-fence gate references after independently verifying that gate was deleted from opum-agent on 2026-09-04, and gained the quest:agent-instructions managed block (via QCLI-227's --target claude, run from source and verified passing --require-installed before AGENTS.md was touched). AGENTS.md deleted with user approval, after confirming with opum-agent that its authority-marker line has zero readers left and independently re-verifying that myself. lore check and quest doctor both clean post-change. .claude/settings.local.json's hardcoded opum-agent hook paths removed (user-scope plugin already covers them); new committed .claude/settings.json carries the OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR/OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN env block. Criterion 3 (hooks fire and land a real tracker note) is NOT satisfied and is recorded as structurally blocked rather than worked around: this repo currently holds three In-Progress tasks (QCLI-196, QCLI-207, this task), and flush-state.sh's own source shows it only writes a note when exactly one is In Progress - confirmed by reading the hook script directly. Resolving that needs QCLI-229 (no legal non-terminal exit from In Progress exists today) or an honest, separately-verified closure of one of the two long-open parent tasks - not something to force here.
